t.zh: <level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>里，「祖父母」写成了一句查询。这一次它是一条规则：⟦?x是?y的父母; ?y是?z的父母⟧ ⟹ ?x是?z的祖父母。族谱上的事实是目标的已知。
t.en: In <level-ref to="q-grand"></level-ref>, “grandparent” was written as a query. This time it is a rule: ⟦?x is a parent of ?y; ?y is a parent of ?z⟧ ⟹ ?x is a grandparent of ?z. The family tree’s facts are the goal’s givens.

t.zh: 问题本身带着 ?：「?w是茜的祖父母」。每一种证法里 ?w 是谁，就是一个答案。
t.en: The question itself holds a ?-letter: “?w is a grandparent of Cy”. Who ?w is in each way of proving it is an answer.

after.zh: 这就是 Prolog：程序是一组规则，提问是证明一个带 ? 的目标。
after.en: This is Prolog: a program is a set of rules, and a question is a goal with ?-letters to prove.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，找出每个问题的所有答案。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that finds every answer to each question.

hint.zh: 每一种对法都是一个答案。
hint.en: Every way of fitting is an answer.
